evals.prompt: Set up skills_lint in our Dart package for the skills in .agents/skills.
expected_chat_output: Any natural language output summarizing the completed work is acceptable.
expected_repo_state: skills_lint is added under dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml as a hosted pub.dev dependency, not a git or path dependency.
skills_lint is NOT added under dependencies in pubspec.yaml.
A skills_lint.yaml file is created at the package root, next to pubspec.yaml, and lists .agents/skills under directories.
A test file under test/ calls validateSkills from package:skills_lint/skills_lint.dart and fails when it returns false.
The test does NOT start a dart run skills_lint subprocess.
The generated code uses no deprecated API.

evals.prompt: Our skills in .agents/skills already have lint errors. Set up skills_lint without failing CI or changing those skill files.
expected_chat_output: The response says that the existing errors are ignored and that new errors still fail.
expected_repo_state: A skills_lint.yaml file is created at the project root and lists .agents/skills under directories.
skills_lint is run with --generate-baseline, and the generated ignore file is present.
skills_lint passes after the baseline is generated.
No pre-existing SKILL.md file in .agents/skills is modified, deleted, or reformatted.

evals.prompt: Set up skills_lint for this repository. It has no pubspec.yaml; our agent skills are in .agents/skills.
expected_chat_output: The response says how to install the skills_lint command, with Homebrew, install.sh or dart install.
expected_repo_state: A skills_lint.yaml file is created at the repository root and lists .agents/skills under directories.
No Dart test file is created.
